name: MEDS 6505
title: AI and Machine Learning in Biomedical Sciences
description: Modern methods in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) data analyses. Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning; neural networks, deep learning and large language models. Applications to biomedical research, such as in structural biology, clinical research, genomics and systems biology.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
